nodes.description: IAxons public axons: the Axons ERC721 token contract address used for mint/burn/transfer of the auctioned NFT.
IAxonsVoting public axonsVoting: external voting contract used for currentWinnerForAuction and setupVoting.
address public axonsToken: external ERC20 ($AXON) token contract used for bids and refunds.
uint256 public timeBuffer: minimum time left in an auction after a bid before extension.
uint256 public reservePrice: minimum accepted bid, stored scaled by 10**18 in initialize.
uint8 public minBidIncrementPercentage: minimum percentage a new bid must exceed the previous bid.
uint256 public duration: length of a single auction.
uint256 public auctionCounter: monotonically increasing counter stored into each Auction and incremented in _createAuction.
IAxonsAuctionHouse.Auction public auction: the single active auction struct (axonId, amount, startTime, endTime, bidder, settled, counter).
initialize(IAxons,IAxonsVoting,address,uint256,uint256,uint8,uint256) external initializer: sets wiring and config, pauses contract, scales reservePrice.
currentAuction() external view: returns a memory copy of the active auction struct.
randomAxonNumber(address,uint256) internal view: pseudo-random axon id derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
settleCurrentAndCreateNewAuction() external nonReentrant whenNotPaused: settles the auction, asks voting for the next axon, creates a new auction and sets up new voting.
settleAuction() external whenPaused nonReentrant onlyOwner: owner-only settlement while the contract is paused.
createBid(uint256,uint256) external nonReentrant: validates bid, refunds previous bidder, pulls $AXON from bidder, updates auction and extends if within timeBuffer.
pause() external onlyOwner: pauses the auction house.
unpause() external onlyOwner: unpauses and may create a new auction using randomAxonNumber.
setTimeBuffer(uint256) external onlyOwner: updates timeBuffer.
setReservePrice(uint256) external onlyOwner: updates reservePrice.
setMinBidIncrementPercentage(uint8) external onlyOwner: updates minBidIncrementPercentage.
_createAuction(uint256) internal: mints an axon via try/catch, stores the new Auction and increments auctionCounter, pausing on failure.
_settleAuction() internal: marks auction settled, burns or transfers the axon, pays msg.sender 1e18 $AXON and burns the remainder.
msg.sender: untrusted caller used as bidder, refund/payout recipient and access-control subject.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for auction start/end, expiry checks, extensions and pseudo-randomness.
IAxonsToken(axonsToken).transferFrom(address(this), lastBidder, _auction.amount): external token call refunding the previous bidder.
token.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount): external ERC20 pull of the bid amount from the caller.
IAxonsToken(axonsToken).transferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, 1e18): pays the caller a fixed 1 $AXON reward during settlement.
IAxonsToken(axonsToken).burn(_auction.amount - 1e18): burns the remaining bid amount.
axons.mint(axonId): external NFT mint call wrapped in try/catch.
axons.burn(_auction.axonId): external NFT burn when the auction had no bidder.
axons.transferFrom(address(this), _auction.bidder, _auction.axonId): external NFT transfer to the winning bidder.
